name: Inferno Abishai
tactics: An inferno abishai wades into the thick of battle, burning its foes as it lays about with its flaming sting and jagged claws. It uses binding flames to punish opponents that try to flee.

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

description: This is the size of a typical human and serves as a standard in the game. This category has no special rules.

traits.name: Limned in Flames
traits.details: while an inferno abishai is bloodied, any enemy that enters the aura or starts its turn within the aura take 5 fire damage.

auras.name: Limned in Flames
auras.details: while an inferno abishai is bloodied, any enemy that enters the aura or starts its turn within the aura take 5 fire damage.

hit.description: fire damage, and the inferno abishai shifts 1 square

effect.description: The inferno abishai makes a claw attack against two different targets.

hit.description: damage, and the target takes ongoing 5 fire damage (save ends)
